function_specs.name: x_malloc
function_specs.meaning: Trusted allocation: return null with no resource or a complete private 32-byte semaphore allocation.

function_specs.name: memset
function_specs.meaning: Trusted zeroing: preserve the complete allocation as a zeroed private semaphore.

function_specs.name: CriticalAreaLock
function_specs.meaning: Preserve caller IRQ prefix, obtain an allowed current OS state, and increment its physical scheduler nesting.

function_specs.name: IdInsertObj
function_specs.meaning: Return full-manager failure with the detached ID unchanged, or register the minimum free ID and transfer its node ownership.

function_specs.name: x_free
function_specs.meaning: Trusted release of the complete zeroed unpublished semaphore.

function_specs.name: CriticalAreaUnLock
function_specs.meaning: Commit the caller guarantee, decrement physical scheduler nesting, and return the same caller IRQ prefix.

function_specs.name: InitDoubleLinkList
function_specs.meaning: Initialize the two owned pointer slots as an empty self-linked list.

function_specs.name: DoubleLinkListInsertNodeAfter
function_specs.meaning: Insert the detached node by updating exactly the four owned link slots.

function_specs.name: _SemaphoreCreate
function_specs.meaning: Return -5 for allocation or ID exhaustion, otherwise publish a fresh semaphore with the minimum free ID, requested value, empty wait queue, and preserved caller task/scheduler/IRQ state.
